description: The 6 archetype templates a company inherits until it is hand-verified (Dossier Part 8 / Roster). Tier-B/C companies map to one of these and are usable day one; Tier-A companies override with a full blueprint. 'default_rounds' is the ordered round-type spine; 'default_skin' picks a platform_skins profile; 'package_band_lpa' is the typical CTC range; 'exotic_rounds' lists which net-new simulators the archetype expects.

mass_service.label: Mass-service (IT services)
mass_service.notes: OA (aptitude + technical/pseudocode MCQ + 1-2 coding) → Technical Interview → HR.

product.label: Product / internet company
product.notes: OA (2 DSA + optional debugging) → 2-3 technical/DSA interviews → HR; optional LLD.

premium_product.label: Premium product (FAANG-tier)
premium_product.notes: OA/phone screen → DSA loop + system design → behavioral/committee/bar-raiser.

analytics.label: Analytics / consulting / finance-tech
analytics.notes: aptitude + stats → case/guesstimate → SQL/ML technical → HR. Case-heavy. (Case round reuses managerial_interview + q_case_study skin.)

core.label: Core engineering (mech / eee / ece / civil / chemical)
core.notes: aptitude + domain MCQ → domain technical → HR.

unique.label: Unique (bespoke, e.g. Zoho)
unique.notes: Bespoke selection process; always Tier A (no meaningful template default).
